scores.notes: Centre: mudbrick wall section tumbling in a dust cloud with the Israelite crowd pouring toward the breach; right foreground priests in white blowing rams' horns and carrying a gilded ark; Joshua centre-right with raised spear. Painting reaches all four edges (sky top, sand bottom); no lettering found on banners, ark or corners.

White-bearded elder lies on a reed mat centre foreground with a staff beside him and seven mourners kneeling with bowed heads; black tents, a stone well and a mud-brick altar sit at right under a dusk sky. Painting reaches all four edges; no lettering seen.

Throne at centre is empty, shown only with fire and radiance; four eye-covered creatures (lion, ox, man-faced, eagle) ring it, crowned elders sit either side, John small at bottom centre with staff on a glassy reflective floor. Jewel shapes arc above the rainbow but no lettering; painting reaches all four edges.

Saul centre shielding his eyes under white rays from the top of the frame; four companions with staffs and two donkeys at left also shading their eyes; a domed city on the right horizon. Light is rays only, no figure in it; all edges painted, no text or marks.

Single veiled woman stands centred among pink roses and white lilies with apple trees at left and right and a village on the far right horizon, head lifted. No shepherd present, painting fills the frame, no text.

Bald Elisha in dark hairy mantle seen from behind-left on the climbing road; a group of youths pour from the town gate at right pointing and shouting; golden calf on a pole and gilded shrine on the hill behind. No text, painting fills all edges.

Abraham at left in white and brown wrap with a bronze knife raised at the top of his reach; Isaac bound at the wrists lying on wood atop a stone altar centre-right; firewood bundle and water skin at the altar's foot, tents and a well in the valley at left, sun rising over the hills. Edges fully painted, no lettering.

Seven seated exiles with lowered heads and arms around knees on a reedy bank in the lower foreground, bundles and a cloak at left and right, misty river and Babylon's walls, blue gate and ziggurat behind under a dusk sky. No instruments, full-bleed edges, no lettering.

Three Roman soldiers kneel in the foreground with dice on a flat stone and garments spread around them; three crosses behind with the crucified figure on the central one, city walls to the right under dark clouds. No title board or lettering; shield bears a sun design only; image reaches all edges.

A huge dome of pale gold light rises over a dark rippled sea with mist at both sides and dark blue void in the upper corners; no figure, face or silhouette anywhere in the light. All edges painted to the border, no text.

Jesus stands upright by the mast, right arm extended over the water, with four disciples clutching the gunwales and a lantern in the lower half; waves still choppy but light breaks through parting clouds behind him. Furled sail, ropes and net are consistent; painting fills all edges, no text.

Three lines of garbled caption text in the upper-left corner of the sky ('Saul of Tarsus, snldyyed trawerder... (Acts 9:3)'). Saul walks on in the beam of light rather than halted with arms raised; companions shield their eyes at right and lower left with donkeys, Damascus on the left horizon. Painting fills all edges.

Grey-haired father in brown cloak mid-run at centre-right clasping the bowed, ragged son by the shoulders on a dusty road; low stone wall, farmhouse gate, fig tree and terraced olive hills at left, lakeside village with boats at right. Painting reaches all borders; no lettering.

Ink-and-watercolor Ezekiel stands centre-right with one arm raised over a valley floor strewn with skulls and bones under a pale blue sky; no figure or voice for God. A small cluster of dark glyph-like scribble marks sits on the sand just right of his robe hem (about x=975, y=410 of 1376x768), reading like tiny lettering on a baseline, and the tablet under his arm carries faint ruled lines; the pale sky is painted to the top edge, not bare paper.

David reclines in green grass beside a still pool with sheep and a stone fold in the distance; a crook, a sheathed sword and a harp lie beside him in place of the requested sling. The harp's curved upper arm (lower right) carries a row of small glyph-like pseudo-letter marks, confirmed on an enlarged crop. Painting reaches all four edges.

Empty rolling green hills and trees under a sky of cream and blue-grey clouds with light brightest at the horizon centre; no sea, no figures, nothing shaped in the light. Paint reaches every edge; no marks or text.

Grey-bearded Daniel at lower left looks up at an empty blazing throne with fiery wheels at upper right; a river of fire pours from it between ranks of white-robed assembly figures, Babylon's buildings and a starry sky behind. The seat is empty, shown only as fire; painting fills all edges, no lettering.

A cloaked traveler with staff walks a cobbled road, cloak lifting, face turned to light breaking through heavy cloud at upper right; village on the left hill, distant walled city, harbour and sea at right, small workers in fields and tiny red-clad soldiers near the gate. Traveler is large in the foreground rather than small in the middle distance. A blank wooden board on a post stands in the right field; enlarged crop shows no lettering. Image fills all edges.

David at left with arm extended after the throw, but the sling itself is flying loose in mid-air at centre-top and the stone is still airborne, while Goliath at centre-right is already reeling backward with a hand raised, dropping his shield, rather than struck and falling on his face; Goliath is also no taller than the other soldiers. Philistines with round shields at right, Israelites on the upper-right ridge and at far left. Edges fully painted, no text.

Jesus stands centre-right with his right arm raised toward a dark rock-cut tomb from which a man wrapped in white grave cloths steps out; a woman in red with clasped hands and a crowd of adults and children shield their eyes at left, village walls and olive trees behind. Full-bleed edges, no text.

The Levite kneels over the concubine, who lies covered to the chin under a red blanket on a mat, knife raised in his right hand and face grief-stricken; oil lamp on a stool at left, bedroll and bag against the wall, donkey framed in the open doorway under stars at right. Restrained, no gore, no text, painting reaches all edges.

Grey-bearded Daniel in blue cloak standing centre in a round stone pit, four lions lying asleep around him; Darius in purple leaning over the rim at upper right with torch-bearing soldiers behind him, a round banded door leaning at upper left and a stair, soft light falling from above with no figure in it. All edges painted; no lettering.

Ezekiel stands centre-right, hand raised, holding a wood-grained tablet, amid bones and skulls on banded teal-and-rust earth; the cream sky washes out to near-paper white along the whole top edge (soft watercolor fade, no hard band or frame). No lettering found on the tablet, ground or corners; God shown by nothing at all.

Jonah lies curled on his side in a dim ribbed fleshy cavity with greenish water pooled beneath him and a faint pale glow through the walls at left and right; no outside figures, no text, painting reaches every edge.

Eight unnamed figures from an old man in front to small children at the back stand in a diagonal line in a stone courtyard with clay jars, an olive tree and a hilltop building; the scroll on the table at lower left is open (not closed as requested) and its exposed sheet carries faint rows of script-like hatching that read as illegible writing. All edges painted.

Moses with staff and Aaron in a jeweled breastpiece and multicolored ephod stand with their backs to us facing a glowing tabernacle in the camp centre, families among tents on both sides, radiance and faint cloud only for God. The woven bands on the lower back of Aaron's ephod (around x=580-650, y=540-560) contain rows of white character-like shapes that read as glyphs or pseudo-lettering rather than plain pattern; painting fills all edges.

Peter sits on the boat's stern rail with one sandaled foot touching the water surface, looking toward Jesus, who stands glowing on the water at right under a moonlit cloudy sky; five disciples grip the rail behind him, distant shore at right. No lettering on the patched sail; image fills all edges.

Job, grey-bearded in blue wrap with a staff, stands left of centre on a smouldering heap of ash and broken pottery looking up at a dust funnel in the upper right with white rays breaking through dark cloud; ruined walled town at left, dead scrub in the lower corners. The radiance is rays and cloud only, no figure; edges fully painted, no lettering on the sherds.

Fireballs streak from a dark sky onto a walled mud-brick city in the lower centre and a second burning town in the middle distance, black smoke rising, glowing bitumen pits at lower right and tiny herders with tents on the hills at upper right. Fire only for Yahweh; full-bleed edges; no lettering on walls or corners.

White-bearded Moses with staff leads a long file of Israelites carrying bundles along dry sand between towering water walls, viewed from the front rather than from behind the file; a pillar of fire glows in the dark clouds behind them as light only, with no figure. No text, painting reaches all four edges.

Peter in brown cloak leaping from the boat's side at centre, feet splashing into the water; the beloved disciple pointing from the boat at left with five other disciples and a net full of fish; Jesus standing on the shingle at right beside a small charcoal fire with a plain soft glow behind his head containing no marks. All edges painted; no text.

White-bearded Moses at left holds a staff and stretches his right arm over a dry sand path between two curling walls of water, with a pillar of cloud and fire glowing above the far shore and Israelite families crowded on the shore at left and right under a starry night sky. God only as the cloud-fire pillar; no Egyptians; painting reaches all edges; no text.

Naomi sits centred on a mat holding the swaddled infant, eight veiled women in earth-toned wraps kneel around her in a mud-brick courtyard with clay jars and folded cloth at lower left, Bethlehem's walls and olive trees beyond the wall at right. No text, painting fills all edges.

A small child in a red tunic walks a dirt path in the lower centre with one hand on a grey wolf and the other on a white lamb; a leopard rests by a stone wall at left, a goat grazes mid-left, a young lion and calf lie together under an olive tree at right, terraced hills and a walled town on the right horizon. Edges fully painted; no lettering.

Isaiah kneels with clasped hands at lower left before a golden altar in a carved temple hall while eight blank-faced seraphim hover in a glowing cloud above; God appears only as radiance from the top. The seraphim show two or four wings each, cover faces with hands rather than wings and none covers its feet, and the foremost holds tongs with a coal (a later verse); door and altar carvings are floral and winged motifs, not letters, and the glow reaches the top edge.
